My father has dementia and he does not recognize me anymore. That makes me sad beyond measure.
</message>
output: I guess what gets me is that he's still here, physically right in front of me, but the person who knew me my whole life is just gone. I keep wanting him to look at me the way he used to, even just once, and it hurts every time he doesn't. I think I'm also scared of what it means that someone can forget you completely, like all those years together just disappeared for him.
